units: command jump total variation in m/s^2; reference jerk in m/s^3; the numerical coefficient 1/96 represents seconds in the declared SI controller
identity: At fixed actual x,v,a, delta_u=800 delta_q+60 delta_qv+1.5 delta_qa+delta_j/96. Piece duration does not enter the jump contribution abs(delta_u).
interpretation: This is exact algebra for frozen polynomial pieces. It does not show equal firmware effort or a significant physical motion change. Infinitesimal-duration jerk excursions can retain finite variation.
